description.value: Tamarind Hill is a Singaporean and Malaysian restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, serving dishes like Singapore Laksa, Char Kuey Teow, Nasi Goreng, and Beef Rendang. It offers a focused, authentic Southeast Asian menu with both meat and seafood specialties alongside a solid selection of vegetarian dishes. Online ordering with quick pickup is available, making it a practical stop for cyclists riding the Lonsdale corridor.
